fundamental.headline: Solid business, but expensive
fundamental.health: Sales up 15% over the last year, it keeps 28 cents of every sales dollar as free cash, its debt is easily covered by earnings.
fundamental.price_text: You're paying more than usual: its price vs sales is higher than 97% of the last 5 years. It also looks pricier than similar companies once growth is considered.
drivers: No big change in growth or margins recently.
news: Recent earnings/results news is news with no clear direction for the company; the stock already reacted, so much of it is likely in the price, and it could matter for months.

timing.label: Critical news

news_impact: How it could affect things: Touches sales growth, profit margins and valuation. Reported results test the growth and margin assumptions in the price.
What would confirm or break it: Confirm: the next report repeats the trend; Break: the next report reverses the trend.
Magnitude: insufficient history of similar events for this company.

attention.text: Attention: Wikipedia page views 4.5k on 2026-11-06, 0.8× its 30-day normal (5.4k/day) · Hacker News: 3 stories in the last 24h (normal 9.9/day), tone of the last week negative.

deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 15% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.8% = 10-year Treasury 4.8% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 15% last year; 8%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 97% (3 years ago 87%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $97 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 118% (3 years ago 156%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $14.8B, up 8% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Inventory up 154% vs quarterly sales up 12% (days of inventory 10 → 22). Products may be building up unsold — a warning sign in chip cycles.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 8%/yr over 3 years and 6%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 33% vs a 5-year range of 29–33% (median 31%): near the top of a fairly narrow range.
deeper.margin_position: near the top of a fairly narrow range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $102.1B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($86.4B buybacks + $15.7B dividends) = 2.1% of the company's market value. Share count down 1.6% from a year ago (buybacks outpacing stock pay).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $10.52, down 2% in 90 days (down 3% in the last 30); 4 analysts raised, 2 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $8.84, up 1% in 90 days; 3 analysts raised, 5 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Vs peers
deeper.text: Compared with 6 peers (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, DELL, QCOM): sales growth 15% vs a median of 20%; operating margin 33% vs 26%; price/sales 10.4× vs 5.3×.

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest year vs a year earlier: Americas 41% of sales, up 11%; Europe 27% of sales, up 15%; Greater China 17% of sales, up 28%; Rest of Asia Pacific 8% of sales, up 18%; 1 smaller. Source: 10-K XBRL.

deeper.title: Insider trading
deeper.text: Last 90 days: no open-market purchases; sales $97.1M, 100% under pre-set 10b5-1 trading plans. Source: SEC Form 4.

deeper.title: New risk factors
deeper.text: 7 new risk-factor headings vs last year's annual report, e.g. “The Company is subject to the risks of adverse impacts from legal proceedings and government investigations.”.
new: The Company’s operations and performance depend significantly on global and regional economic conditions.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +14% vs a year ago · $8.98 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 14%, in step with sales (12%): growth comes from more business, not cost cuts.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running by about 6%, yet the stock fell after 6 of them: beats are already expected.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.read: Sales up 12% from a year ago but slowing (from 17% two quarters ago): the fastest growth may be behind it.
tiles.explain: Growth of quarterly sales (revenue) compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $33 of operating profit, about the same as a year ago.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 103% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 38× last year's profit (higher than 92% of the last 5 years; above peers' 20).
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Jan 28; analysts expect EPS of $2.92, up 3% from a year ago. It usually moves about 3% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.

tiles.title: Forecast changes
tiles.read: Next year's EPS forecast is down 2% in 90 days (4 raised, 2 cut lately): forecasts are steady.
tiles.explain: How the average analyst forecast for next year's earnings per share changed (Yahoo, unofficial).
